internalStateVariables.name: activeTab

internalStateVariables.name: activeTool
internalStateVariables.purpose: Selects which of the 5 thinking tools is active inside the tools tab.

internalStateVariables.name: personFlagRemoved
internalStateVariables.purpose: Tool 1 (Flag): Separates the person (“我”) from the temporary mistake/event (“事”).

internalStateVariables.name: currentLens
internalStateVariables.purpose: Tool 2 (Three Lenses): Switches between My Lens, Peer Lens, and Sky Bird-Eye Lens.

internalStateVariables.name: coinSide
internalStateVariables.purpose: Tool 3 (Two-Sided Coin): Flips between the difficulty side and the caring/intention side.

internalStateVariables.name: isBreakerOpen
internalStateVariables.purpose: Opens DifficultyBreakerModal directly from ThoughtDetectiveLabModal header CTA.

internalStateVariables.name: isCrayonGameOpen

internalStateVariables.name: isTransferLabOpen

internalStateVariables.name: expMetrics
internalStateVariables.purpose: Displays live completedDetectiveCaseIds, hypothesisRevisionCount, and completedTransferScenarioIds.

internalStateVariables.name: boxItems
internalStateVariables.type: Array<{ id: '1'..'5', text: string, correctBox: 'visible' | 'heart' | 'guess', sorted: string | null }>

internalStateVariables.name: circleItems
internalStateVariables.type: Array<{ id: 'c1'..'c5', text: string, correctCircle: 'adult' | 'mine' | 'together', sorted: string | null }>

internalStateVariables.name: currentStep
internalStateVariables.purpose: Mode 4 (Four Steps): Highlights the 4-step cognitive scaffolding ladder (Naming -> Flow -> Hearing Thought -> Testing Thought).

launchesCrayonDetectiveGame.childModeBehaviorWhenPending: Fail-closed: blocks child rendering with friendly preparation card and requires session-bound ParentGateModal + issueAdultPreviewSession(SCOPE_KEY) for adult review.
launchesCrayonDetectiveGame.exitBehavior: onExit sets isCrayonGameOpen=false and refreshes expMetrics via loadProductExperienceMetrics().

launchesTransferScenariosModal.childModeBehaviorWhenPending: Fail-closed per scenario scope (`transfer:${scenario.id}`): blocks child mode until approved or session-bound adult preview token is issued.

launchesDifficultyBreakerModal.exitBehavior: onClose sets isBreakerOpen=false while preserving ThoughtDetectiveLabModal state.

stages.label: STEP 0: 挑选大石头困难 (PICK)
userActions: Or directly select one of 4 transition subbranches (`breaker-pick-sub-sub_dual_attachment`, `sub_loyalty_conflict`, `sub_specific_concern`, `sub_ordinary_transition`)

stages.label: STEP 1: 分 (看清事实、感受与脑中想法)
userActions: Tap SVG crystal pieces or detail cards (`breaker-fen-fact`, `breaker-fen-feeling`, `breaker-fen-guess`) to toggle `fenRevealed.fact | feeling | guess`
Navigate back to `pick` (`breaker-back-to-pick`) or forward to `tong` (`breaker-next-to-tong`)

stages.label: STEP 2: 通 (转动双面透镜，换个角度看看)
userActions: Flip dual-sided perspective lens (`breaker-flip-lens-btn`) toggling `isCoinFlipped` and speaking `silverLining` or `shiftContent`
Navigate back to `fen` or forward to `ze` (`breaker-next-to-ze`)

stages.label: STEP 3: 择 (挑 1~3 块舒服的小踏脚石或主动暂停)
userActions: Place 1 to 3 action cards (`breaker-action-*`) into 3 river stepping-stone slots (`breaker-stone-slot-0..2`)
Remove a placed stone from any slot (`handleRemoveStone(slotIdx)`)
Click voluntary pause (`breaker-pause-btn`) setting `pausedVoluntarily = true` and speaking `PAUSE_SPEECH`
Complete breaker (`breaker-complete-btn`) when `placedStonesCount >= 1`, unlocking `breaker-master` and `action-pioneer` medals

stages.label: STEP 4: 拆解完成总结
userActions: Review chosen stepping stones and companion encouragement (`COMPLETE_SPEECH`)

companionAndVoiceSync.globalSyncMechanism: Calls updatePersonalization({ companionId: compId }) + speechNarrator.syncWithCompanion(compId) and speaks SWITCH_COMPANION_GREETING[compId]
companionAndVoiceSync.subtitleSynchronization: Subscribes to speechNarrator.subscribeKaraoke and speechNarrator.subscribeSpeakingState; displays karaoke.fullText while speaking and falls back to lastSpokenText with replay button (`breaker-replay-speech`).
